title: Heat vs. hue: A molecular tug-of-war in pear fruit coloration
content: Fruits are daily alchemy; every morning, we peel back nature's palette and consume its colors: yellow bananas, orange slices, green kiwis, fiery red apples, golden mangoes, and deep violet grapes. In every fruit lies a language spoken not in words but in color. In a life often dulled by repetition and routine, fruits quietly and beautifully remind us that nature still makes art.
